name: Toxic Deluge
oracle_text:
As an additional cost to cast this spell, pay X life.
All creatures get -X/-X until end of turn.
blocked_sentences: As an additional cost to cast this spell, pay X life.
All creatures get -X/-X until end of turn.

needs.what: an additional cost whose amount is a number the caster announces while casting (601.2b), for a spell with no {X} in its mana cost -- 'pay X life' where X is chosen freely from 0 up to the caster's life total
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `pay_life` in a cost is a fixed integer or a board-derived value expression (War Room), never a player-announced number, and `x_value` is refused outside an activated ability that has a literal '{X}' in its own mana. The nearest shape, `additional_cost` + `additional_optional` + `additional_repeatable` (replicate/multikicker), is an optional cost paid a number of times rather than one mandatory announced X, so it is a different printed sentence and a different legality offer.

needs.what: a value leaf that reads the X announced for a non-mana additional cost, so the spell's effects can be sized by it
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The `x` leaf returns `ctx.x`, and `ctx.x` is only ever filled by `game._ask_x`, which returns 0 unless the cost's mana has an `{X}` symbol (`cost.mana.x_count`). Toxic Deluge's mana cost is {2}{B}, so `x` would silently evaluate to 0 and the sweep would be -0/-0. `additional_paid` counts repeatable optional payments, not an announced X.
